name: Noninformative comparator
preconditions: Define outcome prevalence and sample unit
limitation: Null predictor does not measure medical usefulness

name: Ordinary least squares
algorithm_mechanics: Minimize squared residuals in linear model
preconditions: Check residuals independent errors and outcome scale
limitation: Invalid as binary event probability model

name: Generalized linear model
algorithm_mechanics: Link function maps linear predictor to expected response
biomedical_use_case: Logistic event classifier with binomial family
preconditions: Specify link and family; check class factor and event prevalence
limitation: Binary GLM requires explicit binomial family; no family guessing

name: Penalized linear and logistic regression
preconditions: Fold-local scaling feature IDs and nested tuning
limitation: Coefficient stability depends on correlated predictors and penalty

name: Linear discriminant analysis
algorithm_mechanics: Gaussian class-conditional score with shared covariance
preconditions: Check covariance rank and feature distribution
limitation: Small samples or covariance violations may invalidate discriminant scores

name: Quadratic discriminant analysis
algorithm_mechanics: Gaussian class-conditional score with separate covariances
biomedical_use_case: Nonlinear group boundary with sufficient subjects
preconditions: Enough samples per class to estimate covariances
limitation: Fails easily in singular or high-dimensional covariance settings

name: Classification and regression tree
preconditions: Prune inside resampling and check minimum group sizes
limitation: Single trees can be unstable and overfit

name: C5.0 decision tree/rules
preconditions: Review rule leakage and ruleset complexity
limitation: Threshold/rule interpretations are not causal

name: Random forest
preconditions: Split patient and source grouping before forests
limitation: Impurity importance and apparent accuracy may mislead

name: Ranger random forest
preconditions: Validate group splits and minimal leaf sizes
limitation: Vendor dependencies and model options require exact-version audit

name: Stochastic gradient boosting
preconditions: Tune depth iterations and shrinkage in training folds
limitation: Risk of overfitting and poorly calibrated event probabilities

name: Gradient-boosted decision trees
preconditions: Freeze training/validation and score external shifts
limitation: Many hyperparameters raise leakage/selection-bias risk

name: RBF support vector machine
preconditions: Scale within folds and audit probability calibration
limitation: Kernel scores need not be calibrated risk

name: k nearest neighbors
preconditions: Fold-local scaling and distance-unit compatibility
limitation: High-dimensional distance concentration and site shift

name: Partial least squares
preconditions: Choose number of components within CV
limitation: Component interpretation and feature leakage

name: Principal-component regression
preconditions: Fit PCs inside each training fold
limitation: Leading variance components may miss outcome signal

name: Shallow neural network
algorithm_mechanics: Feedforward nonlinear mapping with weight decay
preconditions: Seed weights scale predictors inside CV
limitation: Can overfit small samples and probabilities need calibration

name: Naive Bayes
preconditions: Audit correlated predictors and class prior
limitation: Independence assumption can distort predicted probability

name: Multivariate adaptive regression splines
algorithm_mechanics: Piecewise hinge functions with interaction selection
preconditions: Tune complexity within analysis folds
limitation: Selected knots/interactions can be unstable

name: Quantile random forest
preconditions: Use valid coverage and group-heldout intervals
limitation: A predicted quantile is not guaranteed calibrated coverage
